issues.claim: heap (type 2, the default) for most services, full only where native memory matters
issues.problem: The cited page says a Heap dump already contains "all memory except for mapped images", so native memory is not what separates Full from Heap. Full adds the module images (mapped images). The page also says only full dumps are supported by the single-file and Native AOT app models. A candidate would wrongly learn that heap dumps lack native memory, and would miss that single-file or Native AOT services are forced to use full.
issues.suggestedFix: EN: "heap (type 2, the default) for most services; full where you need module images in the dump, and for single-file or Native AOT apps, which support only full dumps; the size budget follows from that choice." RU: "heap (тип 2, по умолчанию) для большинства сервисов; full - там, где нужны образы модулей в дампе, и для single-file и Native AOT приложений, которые поддерживают только full; из этого выбора следует бюджет на размер."

issues.claim: for self-contained apps or custom runtime builds the team archives them itself
issues.problem: The dotnet-symbol page says symbol download works for official .NET runtime builds and gives a 404 only for runtimes from other sources, such as source builds or distro builds. A self-contained app ships an official Microsoft runtime, which is normally downloadable. Only custom or distro runtime builds need to be archived by the team.
issues.suggestedFix: EN: "for custom or distro-built runtimes (symbol download returns 404 for them) the team archives the runtime binaries, libmscordaccore.so and symbols itself." RU: "для собственных или дистрибутивных сборок рантайма (для них загрузка символов даёт 404) команда архивирует бинарные файлы рантайма, libmscordaccore.so и символы сама."
